$widen: WIDENED 2026-09-05, Greg: "widen now — widen as chunking is coming". The
east and north edges did not move (x1 430, box y1 740, core y1 500); the
WEST and SOUTH edges did, from x0 -620 / y0 -730 to x0 -1320 / y0 -1130.
WHY. Everything Greg has built since 2026-09-05 is on the KT-22 WEST FACE,
and every metre of it was outside the old box — which meant outside the
stamp raster, and `groundZ` returns bare DEM outside the raster (ground.mjs:
`if (!inRaster(x, y)) return dem`). So the GS Bowl cliff benches, the 75
Chute wall, the box-chute lanes and the ledge field were all built in the
source world and all ABSENT from the export's ground, while the rock meshes
that read `groundZ` to find their own lips stood on the wrong mountain. The
crop was not hiding backdrop any more, it was deleting the feature.

every one of these features has a negative y and the south edge is the one

CORE FOLLOWS on the same two edges, and that is a declaration rather than a
mechanism: the fence has been surface-aware since 2026-08-30 and its hard
box is CORE +/- 8,000 m, so nothing about the fence needed CORE to move.
What moved is the claim. CORE means "the playable area", and the west face
is ridden — the-nose-drop-in is a spawn point on it. Leaving CORE at -470
would have kept saying the face is backdrop after this build stopped
treating it as any. On the west and south edges CORE and BOX are now the
same line; the east and north keep D12's original nudge.
COST, and it is the forcing function for 0052. The stamp raster goes 566 x
777 = 439,782 cells to 916 x 977 = 894,932, and 18 Float32Arrays of it goes
31,664,304 B to 64,435,104 B. `rasterHeapBytes` had to be raised for it (see
that field's own $note). This is the whole D23 argument arriving on cue:
one flat raster sized to a box cannot follow a world that keeps growing
west. specs/0051-0052's per-tile raster is the fix; this is the number that
makes it urgent.

markerFilter.$keep: D37a is POSITIONAL, and as of 2026-08-31 the allowlist is the WHOLE upper mountain (Greg). The positional rule was written when the crop was the product and everything west of CORE was backdrop nobody could reach; then all seven lifts started boarding and the fence became surface-aware, and the far west stopped being scenery — you can ride to it and ski down from it. A place you can stand on with no sign on it is the defect the crop was trying to avoid, not the tidiness it was trying to buy. ALL 18 MARKERS SHIP, and that count has not changed since 2026-09-05; what changed with the crop widening the same day is HOW each one survives. x0 moved -620 -> -1320, so four ids the allowlist used to be carrying — kt22 (-913.4), gs-bowl (-981.3), olympic-lady (-685.1) and the-nose-drop-in (-904.6) — now clear the POSITIONAL half on their own, which is the honest outcome: the KT-22 west face they stand on is inside the export's ground now, not backdrop. Five still need their name, and all five are Gold Coast / High Camp, 2.6-3.0 km west and still outside any raster this build can afford: funitel-top (-2912.5), gold-coast (-2995), mountain-run (-2646.5), high-camp (-2579.3), gold-coast-park (~-2800). The four redundant ids STAY IN THE LIST ANYWAY — an allowlist entry for a marker that also passes positionally costs nothing and fails safe if the box ever narrows again, and the gate asserts this list by exact contents (gate.markersKept), so quietly shrinking it would be a second edit with no reason behind it. Earlier history: 19 markers / 9 kept until 2026-09-05, when Greg deleted the eagles-nest sign outright and the summit sign kt22 took the name; tuning req-20260905-175147 added the-nose-drop-in, the spawn point Greg asked for on that ridge, which the old positional rule missed by 285 m.

skied right off the ramp for about a second down the Snow King Road bench,
and stopped on the flat facing down Champs Elysees. Press W and you commit.

$tuning.arcFromTopM: metres along `alongRun` past the point nearest the lift's top terminal. 0 puts you on the unload ramp (steep); 40+ starts committing you down the cat track before the intro card is gone.
$tuning.searchM: if > 0, search +/- this many metres around arcFromTopM and take the flattest sample. 0 = take the arc distance literally.

$buildMs: specs/0051 §7.3, §9.2 #8, critic A.14 — THIS FIELD CHANGED MEANING, and

older log.
WHAT IT USED TO MEAN: world.report.stats.buildMs, the wall time inside
buildWorld() alone — 1,966 ms on red-dog against a 20,000 cap. The player
waits for nav -> window.__playerReady, which is a different clock: 16,309
ms wall on the same build (§0.4 M8). A cap of 20,000 on the 1,966 ms clock
was measuring the wrong thing with 18 s of slack, and §7.3 records that
the design's proposed 12,000 would have failed on day one against the
clock a player actually feels.
WHAT IT MEANS NOW: navigation start -> window.__playerReady, verbatim
§7.3. verify.mjs's boot() defines an accessor on window.__playerReady
before any page script runs and stamps performance.now() (whose origin IS
navigation start) when main.js:2810 sets it — so this is the definition
measured, not a harness poll interval rounded off. main.js is not touched.

what a first-time visitor gets):

written against the cold one, which is the honest one.
